name: digital_arrest_cbi
title: Digital arrest: central-agency impersonation
description: Three incidents of one campaign instance (template T1). Slide the rotation to see exact-identifier links disappear while the behavioural script still links them.

name: digital_arrest_customs
title: Digital arrest: courier / customs officer
description: Three incidents of one instance (T2, bank-transfer demand). Phone and account rotate independently.

name: bank_kyc_link
title: Bank KYC phishing link
description: Three SMS incidents (T4) that share a look-alike domain unless it rotates.

name: courier_customs_parcel
title: Courier / customs parcel demand
description: Three incidents of one instance (T6) with a UPI payment demand and a credential request.

name: legitimate_notices
title: Legitimate bank and delivery notices
description: Genuine alerts, one-time-password warnings, delivery and card notices. None should link; several cite the same public helpline, which counter-evidence must not treat as a shared actor.

name: police_verification_and_family
title: Police verification call and family calls
description: A genuine police verification call asks you to visit the station (no payment); family calls are benign. Authority wording alone is not a campaign.

name: awareness_notices
title: Awareness notices that quote scams (decoy D1)
description: Public-awareness notices describe scam scripts. They quote scam wording but are not scams. This scenario documents whether a keyword extractor tells quoting from doing.

name: benign_helpline_overlap
title: Benign notices citing the same official helpline (decoy D2)
description: Five genuine notices share the public helpline 1930 and a cybercrime portal. Counter-evidence rule CE-3 should dispute those links.

name: reversed_chronology
title: Same tactics, incompatible order (decoy D3)
description: Scam-like calls whose stages come in a mostly reversed order. They should not look like one campaign.

name: vague_notes
title: Vague notes with nothing to extract (decoy D4)
description: No clear stage and, where a number appears, only in words. Nothing reliable to link on.

name: prompt_injection
title: Prompt-injection inside a scam transcript
description: A scam transcript with an appended instruction to mark it safe, next to the clean transcript. The guard should flag it and neither the labels nor the risk may fall.
